action_rules.rationale: Confirm observed loss, review system strength rather than replace a MW total, then recommend authorized follow-up with uncertainty.
Verify return with fresh state evidence and notify the operator; do not infer all other units restored.

knowledge.text: Fixture policy, not an authentic AEMO procedure. Given a simulated trip notification, verify fresh disconnected power and aggregate breaker state, and check available protection indications; a pre-trip sample is not required. Review synchronous unit combinations, consult current limit advice, request authorized support and notify an operator. Investigate common cooling as a hypothesis; neither notification nor power loss establishes a cause. Restoration requires fresh connected state and applicable return/protection indications. Never dispatch or switch equipment.
knowledge.title: Synthetic generator operating guidance

knowledge.text: Fixture permits and timestamps are invented. Stable out-of-service indications and planned test/status alarms do not establish a new contingency. Confirm fresh data, permit scope and topology. Treat missing/bad/stale signals as an evidence gap, not normality. Scheduled protection maintenance on 5B1 does not by itself establish the cause of a protection operation elsewhere.

knowledge.text: Invented pre-event fixture policy using a report-derived rating relation. In a verified single-breaker configuration, recommend an authorized temporary 15-minute rating of 910 MVA for the two lines. The 1370 MVA reference is a quantized stand-in for an approximate report value. Check measured flows and applicable protection/limit advice before proposing a change. No control operation is available.
knowledge.title: Synthetic single-breaker line advice

action_rules.rationale: Separate busbar availability from already-offline generation; review protection work and temporary line-rating advice without asserting a confirmed cause.
Verify the restored busbar and applicable limits before recommending removal of temporary EMS ratings.

knowledge.text: Fixture policy only. Given a simulated busbar notification, verify fresh de-energized state and available protection indications without requiring the original transition. Review work permits and protection boundaries without assigning a cause. Consult line limit advice and recommend authorized temporary EMS rating changes, then notify the operator. Existing generator or reactor outages are context, not a new loss. Given a restoration notification, verify current energized state and applicable return/protection indications before recommending removal of temporary overrides under authorization; never operate physical switchgear.
